versions.changelog:
ai-amazing-tech 1.0.0

- Initial release of ai-amazing-tech skill.
- Automatically routes user input to one of three modules: 技术全景分析 (Technology Landscape), 专利挖掘 (Patent Mining), or 技术情报简报 (Tech Intelligence Brief), each producing a tailored HTML report.
- Supports input of technology keywords or patent search queries, using PatSnap’s global patent database.
- All reports display actual matched_total of patents, not just samples.
- Unified UI/HTML style adopted across all report types for consistent visual experience.
